plants.sentence: Even though single values carry no probability, whether an interval includes its endpoints changes a continuous probability, so the endpoints must never be treated carelessly.
A normal probability plot of a fitted model's residuals proves the model is correct: if the residuals look normal, every assumption of the model is guaranteed to hold.
With a small p and a small n, a binomial distribution is skewed left: most of the probability sits on large counts and it tails off to the left.
A continuous uniform distribution gives equal probability across a range, which makes it important as a reference distribution and the best default model for real measurement data.
Modelling data with the exponential distribution, as is common in reliability work, is what causes their failure rate to become constant.
